# laravelforge_server_backup_instance (Data Source)

Fetches a single backup instance (a completed backup run) of a backup configuration on a server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_configuration_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the backup configuration the instance belongs to.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the backup instance.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `finished_at` (String) Timestamp the backup run finished.
- `is_partial` (String) Whether the backup is partial.
- `size` (Number) Size of the backup in bytes.
- `status` (String) Status of the backup run.
